# Vendored fishash source

The runtime functions are vendored from `jackkamm/fishash` commit
`74220e8` (package version 0.99.0), matching the version used for the
benchmark. Only `R/fishash.R` and `R/impute_masked_counts.R`, which are
required by the assignment entrypoint, are included. Upstream license files
are retained in this directory.
